offering_description.value: Builds and sells new homes to buyers through local sales teams and real estate agents. It develops residential lots for builders and builds single-family and apartment rental communities for sale to investors. Its financial services operations originate home mortgages and provide title and closing services.

primary_products.value: single-family homes; townhomes; finished residential lots; single-family rental communities; apartment communities

primary_services.value: mortgage origination; title insurance and settlement; residential leasing

customer_segment.value: B2C: Homebuyers, mortgage borrowers and residential tenants; B2B: Homebuilders, rental property investors and mortgage loan purchasers

end_markets.value: new-home sales; residential land development; single-family rentals; multifamily rentals; residential mortgage and title services

revenue_model.value: product sales: New homes, finished lots and completed rental communities; service fees: Mortgage origination and closing services; other: Sale of originated mortgage loans to secondary-market purchasers; interest or premiums: Mortgage interest and title insurance premiums; rental or leasing: Tenant rent while residential rental properties are held
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; other; interest or premiums; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Uses land, materials and subcontracted labor to build homes for buyers and rental communities for investors; raw materials: Develops land into finished residential lots for homebuilders; financial intermediary: Originates mortgages for homebuyers and sells the loans to secondary-market purchasers; service provider: Provides title and settlement services for residential property transactions; asset operator: Owns and leases single-family and multifamily rental properties before sale
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; raw materials; financial intermediary; service provider; asset operator

geography_served.value: US national: Multiple U.S. regions, including the South, Midwest, Mountain West and Pacific Coast

specialization.value: related lines: Homebuilding, residential lot development, rental communities, mortgage origination and title services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Builder sales teams for homebuyers and direct deals with builders and rental property investors; own locations: Model homes and sales offices in residential communities; agents / brokers: Independent real estate agents representing homebuyers; online: Company websites for home listings, buyer inquiries and mortgage applications
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; agents / brokers; online

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Mortgage and title licensing under state regulators, federal consumer lending rules, and local zoning and building permits
